chapter: Back in New York: Heard and Dizzy
title: Ella Fitzgerald that week and rooming with Chano Pozo
summary: Ella was the star that week in Detroit; Chano Pozo was already with Dizzy and became his roommate.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: A week. And then we went on the road. For that week, Ella was the star and she'd caught ahold of bop and she was scattin' and she was pickin' up and everything. It was a good week. Chano Pozo was with him; that's when I first saw Chano.
He was already with Dizzy when you joined the band?
Yeah. And Chano and I became

roommates and he loved the band so, you know, and he was a showman. And, you know, it was just touching to see when the guys would finish the engagement, he'd fold the uniforms up and put 'em away. I never forgot that.
